reviewSamples.author: Cindy Alexander
reviewSamples.text: Will definitely hire 2 Veterans Handyman Services again. My friend recommended them to me and they were fantastic! I really appreciated the fact that I asked them on a Friday when they could do my job and they were available Monday morning.

reviewSamples.author: Jim
reviewSamples.text: The service Todd and Phillip provides is awesome! They've done several jobs for me and was professional and got the jobs done right. They have installed 2 wall mounted TVs with hidden wires, installed ceiling fans and light fixtures. Along with installing a dog door. I definitely would refer them to anyone looking for installs or repairs around the house.

reviewSamples.author: Learning parkour
reviewSamples.text: These guys are very good at handyman jobs. I had a few things around the house that needed fixing my light bulb socket was loose. When the tech was finished everything looked beautiful. He had fixed all my issues. I would highly recommend this company.
